summary: iPower Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a plan to evaluate expansion into the AI infrastructure hardware sector, including potential acquisition or financing of AI compute hardware and related infrastructure assets. The press release states it is at an exploratory stage, with no specific terms, stake, price, premium, or timeline disclosed. The company may consider leasing equipment to data centers and operators. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The announcement is a preliminary strategic review with no binding deal. Watch for further updates on potential transactions; risk-arb angle is not applicable yet.
